title: 6 Things to Know about AIE World's Fair 2026
talk_summary: This is a conference logistics/announcement video by an AI Engineer World's Fair co-founder describing tracks, expo layout, side events, and attendee perks.

takeaways.technique: Human-preferred support over chatbot for common questions
takeaways.what_they_do: They expect a chatbot to go unused for newbie orientation and staff human meetups instead, because attendees want to talk to humans.
takeaways.evidence_quote: We have a chatbot. No one's going to use it. We know this. So, we just people want to talk to humans

takeaways.technique: Map-reduce division of parallel tracks across a team
takeaways.what_they_do: Attendees split across 10-12 simultaneous tracks, one per person, then reconvene to share findings like a map-reduce.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you just split up with your team, pick like one per one track per person and then you gather it back at the end of the day, sort of like a map reduce
